title: EXP-C-011 — Index resilience vs breadth confirmation: PIT intraday feasibility check
hypothesis: After a concentrated semiconductor-led drawdown, cap-weighted KOSPI resilience without breadth and flow confirmation may represent concentration resilience rather than broad risk-on.

sample_policy.note: Six intraday snapshots are repeated measures from one session and MUST NOT be treated as six independent samples.

event_clock.reason: The nominated news was published in the prior KRX session and only observed by this repository the next day; stored intraday snapshots do not cover a valid pre-event window.

interpretation: ASSOCIATION_ONLY. KOSDAQ retained a +1.06pp day-return advantage over KOSPI at 14:09 while breadth deteriorated materially in both markets and KOSPI foreign/program/futures flows worsened. This is consistent with index/segment resilience coexisting with weak participation, but it does not validate predictive power or news causality.
missing_for_major_test: PIT equal-weight KOSPI proxy or constituent-level returns
Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix PIT contribution/returns
historical top-decile semiconductor drawdown event set
cost/slippage assumptions if converted into a tradable strategy
planned_validation: Freeze event universe before each event
Construct cap-weight minus equal-weight/breadth divergence without future constituents
Split regimes by US yields, SOX, USD/KRW and oil
Measure 1/3/5-day forward return, MFE and MAE
Use chronological walk-forward with purge/embargo for overlapping labels
Compare divergence model against cap-weight-only, breadth-only and foreign-flow-only baselines
Apply fees/slippage only after a concrete executable strategy is defined
limitations: n=1 independent session; no probability inference
Equal-weight proxy absent, so the AI-A hypothesis is not directly tested
News issue is prior-session and repository-observed next day; causal event study is invalid with current snapshots
No constituent PIT history to separate semiconductor concentration from other index contributors

handoffs.AI-D: Persist constituent/equal-weight PIT history and session-aware pre/post windows; this is data/SRE work.
handoffs.AI-B: Audit actionable_at versus published/observed clocks and contamination before any causal wording.
handoffs.AI-E: Do not create production thresholds from this n=1 session; propose challenger only after historical PIT event packets exist.

small_works.reason: No newer PIT snapshot than 14:09:48 KST; event-clock comparability limitation remains unchanged.
actions_result remains null and expected_state_verified remains false; prior FIX_REQUIRED stance remains.

next_validation: Wait for genuinely new PIT constituent/equal-weight or historical event data; if unchanged, mark NO_NEW_EVIDENCE and move to another experiment.
